decision: H1R-04 remains product-pending. Correct the discovery census so the one exact, schema-validated canonical ABC run record cannot invalidate the product-state snapshot merely because its revision advances. Preserve fail-closed discovery for every other repository document and executable path; do not classify the remaining product candidates in this correction.

supersedes_acceptance_of.scope: Only the denominator boundary and manifest schema described here are corrected. The 17 seed mappings, ten mandatory post-r3 candidates, Git inventories, path safety, raw-blob framing, limits, no-live boundary and CLI behavior remain authoritative unless this document explicitly changes them.

observed_failure.reproduction: After the discovery candidate passed validation, releasing its ABC claim advanced the canonical run record. The unchanged product tree then failed --expect-unclassified with exit 1 and errors=["identity_mismatch"].
observed_failure.root_cause: The mutable orchestration control plane was included in the product-state census. The act of recording acceptance changed a manifest member after validation, creating an unavoidable self-invalidating cycle.
observed_failure.acceptance_correction: The prior implementation remains useful rejected evidence but is not a stable accepted census until this correction is implemented, independently reviewed and proven across a post-manifest run-record transition.

boundary_contract.exact_match_rule: A control-plane record matches only one normalized POSIX path equal to an item in control_plane_records_exact. No prefix, suffix, case-folded, glob, regex, basename or substring match is allowed. Every other file beneath docs/plans/evidence and docs/plans/handoffs remains in the ordinary census denominator and candidate rules.
boundary_contract.inventory_and_read_rule: The exact record remains part of the Git inventory. Before exclusion it must be read in full with the existing read_safe_file primitive and max_file_bytes limit, thereby applying normalized-path, containment, component lstat/reparse, regular-file, descriptor identity and post-read TOCTOU checks. Read-and-discard is required; a validate-only shortcut is forbidden. Inventory and path-safety errors retain their existing fail-closed codes.
boundary_contract.document_rule: The exact raw bytes must contain no NUL, decode as strict UTF-8, not begin with '#!', and parse through the duplicate-key-rejecting JSON loader. The top-level object must have exactly the keys in control_plane_schema.top_level_fields_exact and satisfy every fixed/type invariant there. On POSIX, any executable permission bit fails. The safe-read identity must be strengthened to retain the complete st_mode permission bits and st_ctime_ns: executable bits must be zero and the complete mode must agree across initial component lstat, descriptor fstat before and after reading, and final component lstat. A chmod or permission drift during the read fails toctou_changed; a stable executable bit, content or schema violation fails control_plane_record_invalid.
boundary_contract.authority_rule: Only the exact validated record is treated as mutable orchestration state and denied Harbour product/canonical/writer authority. It is not a manifest member. All architecture, evidence, roadmap, source and test files, including all siblings in its directory, remain discoverable. No seed or mandatory post-r3 path may equal a control-plane record or self-exclusion.
boundary_contract.enumeration_count_rule: files_enumerated counts safe inventory members after the three exact self-exclusions and the one exact validated control-plane record exclusion. candidates_detected and member_set_digest cover only the remaining product-state candidates.
boundary_contract.ordering_rule: Apply exact self-exclusion and exact control-plane record validation in UTF-8 path-byte inventory order. The validated record does not contribute candidate identity, total_text_bytes, counts or member digest.
boundary_contract.no_silent_broadening: Only the exact record path is accepted. Another run record or path requires a separately reviewed contract amendment and refreshed manifest; it must never be inferred from directory, filename or content.

control_plane_schema.type_invariants: revision, max_parallel_workers and heartbeat_interval_minutes are nonnegative JSON integers but not booleans; active_claims, agent_leases, evidence_reviews, reflect_assessments and correction_history are arrays; readiness, route and initial_packet are objects; scope, authorization, started_at, deadline_at, heartbeat_policy, resume_cursor and last_durable_progress_at are nonempty strings.

effective_contract_patch.scan_contract_digest_rule: Compute scan_contract_digest over the complete effective census_contract: the exact r1 census_contract plus a control_plane_record_boundary object containing the entire exact boundary_contract. Do not hash the diagnostic observed_failure object.
effective_contract_patch.manifest_rule: The manifest must contain both exclusion arrays exactly as declared, in order. No manifest entry may equal an exact infrastructure exclusion or exact control-plane record. All r1 entry ordering, classification combinations and seed mapping rules remain unchanged.

scanner_requirements: Bind this correction architecture by exact raw blob and bind the r1 architecture by its existing exact raw blob.
Construct one effective in-memory contract without editing either architecture artifact.

Read and validate the exact control-plane record safely before excluding it and fail with the new fixed error control_plane_record_invalid for schema, content, permission or forbidden required-path overlap.
Strengthen the shared safe-file identity to compare complete st_mode and st_ctime_ns so permission-only races are detected without weakening any existing path check.
Emit and validate schema_version 2 manifests with the exact control_plane_exclusions field and an effective-contract digest.
Keep discovery read-only and preserve all r1 failure redaction, deterministic output and no-live guarantees.
implementation_scope.manifest_regeneration_rule: Regenerate the complete manifest from a fresh real-repository discovery under the corrected effective contract. Preserve the exact 17 seed classifications and mark every other remaining candidate unclassified. Do not infer any new disposition in this correction.
forbidden_changes: No product-roadmap or H1R-04 status update.
No state classification beyond the existing 17 seed mappings.
No migration, database access, provider/network access, private-data read, deletion, deployment, push or other live effect.
No modification of Codex configuration, skills or runtime files.

hostile_tests: The exact canonical run-record JSON is inventoried, read with read_safe_file, schema-validated and excluded; mutating only legal mutable fields leaves candidate membership, digest and manifest validation unchanged.

A product-authority-shaped JSON or Markdown created under docs/plans/evidence or docs/plans/handoffs remains governed by ordinary candidate discovery and invalidates a stale manifest when it qualifies.

A .py, arbitrary JSON, shebang document, duplicate-key JSON, wrong run_id/kind, unexpected top-level field or POSIX executable-mode file at the exact record path fails or remains unexcluded as required; none can hide behind the boundary.
A reparse point, symlink, nonregular file or descriptor/content mutation at the exact record path still fails with the corresponding existing path-safety or TOCTOU error.
A chmod that adds, removes or swaps executable permission during the exact-record read is detected from complete mode/ctime identity and fails toctou_changed.
Near-path siblings remain in the denominator and cannot be hidden by the exclusion.
Any seed or mandatory path equality with an exclusion fails closed.
Manifest schema 1, missing/reordered/extra exclusion fields, wrong prefixes or a digest computed over r1 alone fail manifest_mismatch.
real_repository: Fresh discovery and schema-2 manifest regeneration complete with all 17 exact seeds and at least one unclassified product candidate.

After the implementation claim is released and the canonical run record necessarily changes, the same unchanged manifest again returns exit 0 with identical candidates_detected, classified_count, unclassified_count and member_set_digest.
The exact record validates in both running and paused lifecycle states, while unknown states fail control_plane_record_invalid; pausing alone cannot recreate census identity drift.
Default validation still returns exit 2 with only unclassified_candidates while product candidates remain unclassified.
Harbour/USI dependency tests and the Round6, Integration Spine and Guidance validators remain green.
acceptance_gates.independent_review: Two independent reviewers must verify exact candidate bytes. At least one must focus on exclusion-boundary bypasses and one on manifest/digest/currentness semantics. Any FAIL keeps the correction and H1R-04 unaccepted.

next_step_after_acceptance: Resume the separately reviewed disposition architecture for the remaining product-state candidates. Do not let mutable ABC control-plane documents consume or invalidate that product classification work.
